create_voting_module: create a VotingModule with a vote factor and seed feature dimension for 3D point cloud voting
run_voting_module_forward: run the VotingModule forward pass with seed XYZ coordinates and seed features to generate votes
build_vote_offsets: build vote offset predictions from seed point features using the VotingModule convolutional layers
test_voting_module_shapes: test the VotingModule by passing random tensors and verifying output tensor shapes match expected dimensions
review_voting_module_residual_features: review the VotingModule residual feature computation that adds offsets to seed features for vote features
